title: L1-planning-readout-generator agent_output
description: This is a pure meta-point index, NOT the readout itself. readout.md is the full, authoritative artifact, saved to blob storage separately (see storage.readout_md_url) — this JSON object is what is printed directly in the agent's response, and is the ONLY output ever consumed programmatically by Phase 2 agents for routing/gating. No field here may contain narrative/prose content duplicated from readout.md; every field is either an id, an enum, a count, a boolean, or a URL. A separate plain-text execution_summary (bullet points, not JSON) is appended AFTER this object in the agent's response — it is not a field of this schema.

readout_id.description: Unique id of the readout.md artifact just produced. Format: artifact-<uuid>.

product_name.description: Product/feature name, carried from prd.md's title. Not a summary field — this is an id-like label, not prose.

prd.description: Artifact id of the source prd.md, or null if that source was unavailable (see sources_available.prd).

impact_assessment.description: Artifact id of the source impact-assessment.md, or null if unavailable.

dependency_graph.description: Artifact id of the source dependency-graph.mmd, or null if unavailable.

requirement_ids.description: Every FR-NNN carried into Section 2, same ids and order as prd.md. Empty array only if prd.md itself was unavailable.

overall_impact_level.description: Carried verbatim from impact-assessment.md's Impact Summary. 'Unknown' only if impact-assessment.md was unavailable.

blast_radius_rollup.description: Computed directly from Section 3's Components Identified table — counts of Blast Radius values, never re-scored.

dependency_graph_status.description: 'valid' = graph rendered with no upstream cycle/validation flag. 'cyclic' = rendered WITH the warning callout (never suppressed). 'unresolved' = dependency-graph.mmd was unavailable from all three input channels.

sources_available.description: Whether each of the three source documents was resolved via any input channel. false triggers a 'Not available' section in readout.md rather than a hard failure.

open_question_count.description: Count of FR-tagged Open Questions bullet items carried into Section 5 (excludes the separate Coverage gap line, if present).

flags_present.description: true if Section 7 (Flags & Data Quality) carries forward one or more flags from impact-assessment.md; false if that section states 'None'.

readout_md_url.description: Blob storage location readout.md was saved to. This is the only blob write this agent performs — agent_output itself is never written to blob.
